subagents_max_concurrent.label: Max Concurrent Subagents
subagents_max_concurrent.help: Upper limit of concurrently active subagents, default 20, range 1~20.

subagents_token_budget.label: Token Budget
subagents_token_budget.help: Context token budget for a single subagent step. Default 200000.

subagents_api_timeout_secs.label: API Timeout
subagents_api_timeout_secs.help: Timeout for a single subagent model call, default 120s, range 1~1800.

subagents_heartbeat_timeout_secs.label: Heartbeat Timeout
subagents_heartbeat_timeout_secs.help: How long a subagent with no response is considered stuck and cleaned up, default 300s, range 30~3600, must be greater than api_timeout_secs.

subagents_default_model.label: Default Subagent Model
subagents_default_model.help: Fallback model when no role is specified.

subagents_max_depth.label: Max Depth
subagents_max_depth.help: Maximum hierarchy depth for recursive subagent delegation

subagents_launch_concurrency.label: Launch Concurrency
subagents_launch_concurrency.help: How many subagents to start simultaneously in one turn before queuing the rest. Prevents burst rate limiting

subagents_max_admitted.label: Max Admitted
subagents_max_admitted.help: Total number of subagents including running and queued. High fan-out tasks can queue, but runtime launch pressure is controlled

subagents_worker_model.label: Worker Model
subagents_worker_model.help: Model for executing specific coding/modification tasks

subagents_explorer_model.label: Explorer Model
subagents_explorer_model.help: Model for exploring codebase, searching files

subagents_awaiter_model.label: Awaiter Model
subagents_awaiter_model.help: Model for waiting for external events, polling results

subagents_review_model.label: Review Model
subagents_review_model.help: Model for code review, validating results
